QuestInfo.name: [8th Day of Memories] Memories Forever
QuestInfo.0: You completed all 7 days of Making Memories. But why stop now?
QuestInfo.1: There are always more memories to make! Collect 50 Roasted Turkeys once again and bring them to #p9010010#. You just might receive a special gift.
QuestInfo.2: The Memory Box... You see that #p9010010# wants to treasure her memories by keeping them close.

0.0: You finally finished all 7 days of Making Memories! I guess those memories are precious to you, too. That's why I prepared a little something extra for you, if you're interested.

yes.0: Each memory is precious, but my favorite ones are from Thanksgiving. I finally acquired my taste for turkey, and I've been stuffing my face with it since! Let's re-live the good old days...by you bringing me 50 Roasted Turkeys again. Remember, you won't find any on monsters who are more than 10 levels below you or 20 levels above you!

no.0: You're kidding, right? I set this up for you! Don't be like that!

default.0: Talk to me again when you have at least one empty slot in your Use inventory.
